children.game_version: Turn the five-beat sequence into a rhythmic game with a partner.

avoid: Rapid chest beating if it causes discomfort
Excessive movement if balance is compromised
seniors.seated_version: Perform the thigh-clap-chest sequence while seated in a stable chair.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the sequence while standing with support if needed.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Hands are used to strike thighs and chest; arms move in coordination with the rhythmic sequence.

signature_moves.description: A five-beat sequence: two thigh slaps, one clap, two chest beats.
signature_moves.name: Thigh-Clap-Chest Sequence

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: A five-beat cycle corresponding to the body percussion sequence.
music_profile.sound_description: The music is defined by the deep, resonant thud of a plywood sheet struck by palms, punctuated by the sharp, high-pitched tone of a metal whistle and the metallic clatter of castanets.

basic_steps: Hit both thighs with both hands twice.
Clap hands once on the third beat.
Beat the chest twice on the fourth and fifth beats.
teaching.level_notes: Beginner: Focus on the rhythm of the thigh-clap-chest sequence before adding movement.

platform: Validated voice/movement feedback and accessible controls
Human BDF consent/matching, moderation and measured session synchronization
Tested camera/split-screen delivery; AR remains an optional future adapter
